papers.title: SO-Arena: Benchmarking the Capability Spectrum and Reliability of System One Models
papers.summary: SO-Arena evaluates System One models across domains and capability families, revealing that scaling and reasoning gains vary and that high overall accuracy does not ensure reliable decision-making.

papers.title: BirdDreams: Joint Perspective and BEV Video Generation for a Plausible, Reactive Driving World Model
PhysLoop: Harnessing LLMs' Physics Awareness for Self-Improving Video Generation Models
papers.summary: PhysLoop leverages large language models to guide video generation, selection, and correction, enabling physically consistent self-improvement and controllable data construction for video models.

papers.title: G-STAR: Group-Scaled Token Capacity for Deeply Compressed Autoregressive Generation
Duo: A Reciprocal World Model for Full-Duplex Interaction
papers.summary: A reciprocal world model enables real-time full-duplex audiovisual interaction by jointly modeling intent and realization using autoregressive reasoning, synchronized attention, and dual rollout distillation.
